resources.name: status
resources.description: Lane status: driver, lander, engine, capacity, switches, locks, strictness and the queue (the status strip and Lane control).

resources.name: score
resources.description: The scorecard: landed, per hour, cost per landed card, flow and spend; the newest per-card rows.

resources.name: modes
resources.description: Drafting modes: the scorecard by mode (today, all, by model, last 10) and the drafting-mode comparison windows.

resources.name: jobs
resources.description: Agent jobs: kinds, schedules, live and finished runs, asks and queues, today's count and spend.

resources.name: agents
resources.description: Live agents and the roster counts (who is working, on what, at what cost).

resources.name: forge
resources.description: The forge: how much of what it found it fixed by itself today, what it is fixing, and its findings.

resources.name: features
resources.description: Feature requests: building, queued, waiting, open, failed and landed today, and the open questions.

resources.name: orphans
resources.description: Orphaned work: counts, the ledger invariant, and the items a console can land, discard or hand (orphans.* actions).

resources.name: pipeline
resources.description: The work pipeline: the lane's cards by stage, counts, the system and production lanes, stranded cards and the release alert.

resources.name: production
resources.description: Production releases per app (state, how far ahead, the next action) and per-app readiness.

resources.name: appkpis
resources.description: App KPIs: one row per studio app and the summary (alerts, off target, launch).

resources.name: syskpis
resources.description: System KPIs: the forge KPI registry grouped by area and its summary.

resources.name: board
resources.description: The board's frame: columns, counts per column, the apps filter, when it was read (the cards are board/cards).

resources.name: models
resources.description: Model use: spend by model, calibration, the drafting waterfall, escalations and the mid-tier rows.

resources.name: halo
resources.description: The Halo: model jobs, servers, machine vitals, memory budget, generation and lane use.

resources.name: halocaps
resources.description: Halo capabilities: what the Halo does for agents per model and infra piece, each with its measured status.

resources.name: halosave
resources.description: Halo savings: the headline, net, live and shadow savings, bars per day and the newest uses.

resources.name: balancer
resources.description: The Balancer: the share of Claude spend saved today, by executor and by who, and the daily bars.

resources.name: hygiene
resources.description: Board hygiene: relevance, refusals, landed-not-released, awaiting release, ready work refused, stale reviews.

resources.name: events
resources.description: The event feed: the newest lane events (time, source, type, class, text and their product words).

resources.name: office
resources.description: The office: who is at which desk, the queue, the Halo row and today's landed and failed counts.

resources.name: home
resources.description: The home column: the three faces (overview, door to landing, speed), the save forecast, the key-number inputs (commits today, throughput, velocity bar, landed rate, worktree and features key cards, saved vs off, reset retention) and the office's facts and shape.

resources.name: board/cards
resources.description: Every open card on the board (archived excluded): id, FA, title, column, priority, estimate, parent, children, links, paused, triaged, chips, app and lane stage.

resources.name: board/card/{fa}
resources.description: One open card with everything board/cards carries plus its body, its notes (the newest 16000 characters) and its open questions.

resources.name: halomodels
resources.description: The Halo model list: each model's id, name, kind, size, whether it is on, its state and memory, what uses it and why it is waiting (halo.setModel turns one on or off).

resources.name: appdata
resources.description: Production app data: the collector, the publish to the app-data ref, the public Funnel (on or off, its endpoint) and the plain-words state (appkpis.funnelOn turns the Funnel on).

resources.name: estimate
resources.description: The estimate panel: the spend baseline, savings by lever and the ratios the scorecard window shows.

resources.name: budget
resources.description: The Budget: the % of the weekly account limit the fleet may use per day (pctPerDay) or Auto, the value in force, its pace line, flags and notes (budget.set changes it).

resources.name: release
resources.description: Push to remote: how many commits local master is ahead of its upstream, the newest subjects, why a push cannot go, and the last push (read only; the push itself is the console's act).

resources.name: jevsavings
resources.description: JEV + JevGrep savings: today and the week, the per-day series (live and replay), the workload table and the levers.

resources.name: account
resources.description: The Claude account the lane runs on: its label and tone, the Halo login match, the plan usage windows, and a sign-in or swap in flight (its steps and links; account.start, account.code and account.step drive it).

resources.name: master
resources.description: Messages with master: the newest 30 of the thread (the console's messages and master's replies, whole), and the reply times for the header's unread count (master.send sends one).

resources.name: android
resources.description: The phone app: whether a phone is attached, its install state and its steps, and what the header pill says (android.install installs).

resources.name: queueview
resources.description: The commit queue: what is queued to land and what landed, as the queue window's text and its counts.

resources.name: jevbuild
resources.description: JEV build: the decision points being built, each with its units and counts.

resources.name: questions
resources.description: The console questions: the open ones (each with its options, why, area and priority), the newest 30 answered, and the counts (questions.* answer them).

resources.name: issues
resources.description: Issues: each stuck card, what was tried at each tier, the refusal and what is wanted next (issues.act retries, changes the tier or closes one).

resources.name: appdialog
resources.description: The Apps picker: each app's staging (exists, built, running) and picture state (apps.staging starts staging).
